title: Content-only session summary can consume a pending prompt without adopting its message
outcome: Delegated review found that ui/src/session-reconcile.ts content-only summary adoption intentionally ignores next-only messages but pending-prompt reconciliation still scans every next message. A next-only message can remove a matching pending prompt without entering the resident message list, hiding the prompt until later hydration. Deferred with the current scroll/reconcile work at the user's direction. Add an anomalous/index-inconsistent summary regression and reconcile pending prompts only against adopted messages.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 3a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The three adoption modes exist in ui/src/session-reconcile.ts (preserve-head) on master.
